translations.web: You make us a byword among the nations, a shaking of the head among the peoples.
translations.bsb: You have made us a byword among the nations, a laughingstock among the peoples.
translations.kjv: Thou makest us a byword among the heathen, a shaking of the head among the people.
translations.asv: Thou makest us a byword among the nations, A shaking of the head among the peoples.
